scope: Strict competency-review queue contract and explicit PESTEL read projections

invariants: location_id, limit, and offset match the request
levels are finite numeric values from zero through five with at most two decimal places, and target is not below current
competency_key follows the migration-defined lowercase key pattern
status is submitted and private actor/reviewer fields are excluded
item count, has_more, and next_offset agree with total and the 10000 offset cap
draft IDs are unique and results follow updated_at DESC, id DESC
Gateway suppresses SQL continuations beyond the request offset cap and the console reports remaining records
OpenAPI documents the NUMERIC(4,2) precision with multipleOf 0.01
malformed responses return a generic no-store error

preserved_behavior: optional location filter remains unchanged and omission still lists all analyses
factor filtering remains analysis_id and factor ordering remains category, factor_type

verification.pestel_test_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_pestel.py -k 'list_analyses_uses_explicit or list_analyses_preserves_intentional or get_analysis_uses_explicit' -q
